gradient_stream: raw noisy gradient actually supplied to AdamW
epsilon_meaning: realized normalized noise contribution, not optimizer numerical epsilon
smoothing: complete finite trailing arithmetic means after computing each per-pair quantity
undefined: first update or either adjacent raw norm zero; no denominator floor
matched: start (0,1), 2000 updates, AdamW betas (0.9,0.95), numerical eps 1e-8, weight decay 0.1, constant LR, no clipping, CPU float64
noise_pairing: one PCG64 seed 1234; same standard-normal draws at all nonzero sigmas and LRs
execution: local postprocessing of immutable Runs038-052; no new optimizer trajectories
interpretation: SGD-derived proxy evaluated on AdamW; neither column is a validated directional-curvature or largest-eigenvalue estimator
